name: fxf_loc002_curtain_ctl
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/loc002_curtain_ctl.state: from the opening's curtain (fxf_loc002_intro_curtain) A every 12 frames 80 times through Mom's wake-up talk (storyline 0 -> 3 at f886), then idle: control returns at f1049 ($011F = 01) and the state is 62 frames later, as the reference was (its control returned at its f664, the capture at f726). Crono's room with the curtain open; slot 1's second E4 pair has run ($7F0142 = 40). The cat (obj 9) wanders elsewhere than in the reference.
